Sandbox_BatteryPoweredClocks_DrainPerDay: Percentage points lost per in-game day. 0 disables battery drain.
Sandbox_BatteryPoweredClocks_MinInitialC: Lowest possible starting charge before optional apocalypse-age drain is applied.
Sandbox_BatteryPoweredClocks_AgeInitialB: Apply elapsed in-game days of drain to a clock when first encountered. Eventually every untouched clock will run out.
Sandbox_BatteryPoweredClocks_AutoSetOnRe: Automatically set time when inserting a battery
If enabled, inserting a battery sets the correct time only when the character carries a watch.
